summary: pi Ventures describes itself as India's pioneering deep tech and AI fund, making early-stage bets on Indian innovators solving global problems. Its homepage gives a fund at a glance: nine years, more than 25 portfolio companies, a current fund of $85,000,000 and a cheque size of $250,000 to $3,000,000, with portfolio examples such as Agnikul Cosmos, Locus and Quanfluence. Contact is by published email. Stage definition beyond early stage, an application form and a street address are not stated.

investmentEvidence.fact: Listed on the homepage as a portfolio company (3D printed rockets). Round and date are not stated.
